PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.

   C. CPU

   A. Remove all guards
